title: The Artist
description: The arrival of sound in motion pictures signals the end of one superstar's (Jean Dujardin) career, while a young ingénue (Bérénice Bejo) stands poised to hit the big time.

title: The Great Race
description: The Great Leslie (Tony Curtis) and sinister professor Fate (Jack Lemmon) enter their wacky cars in a 1908 race from New York to Paris.

title: Tribute to a Bad Man
description: An Easterner (Don Dubbins) goes to work for a Colorado rancher (James Cagney) who keeps law and order with a rope.

title: Executive Suite
description: Four VPs and a junior executive (William Holden) jockey for power in a company run by the founder's daughter (Barbara Stanwyck).

title: Blood on the Moon
description: A Texas gunfighter (Robert Mitchum) helps an old friend (Robert Preston) stir up a feud between ranchers and settlers.

title: Born to Kill
description: A private eye (Walter Slezak) hunts a killer (Lawrence Tierney) who marries a divorcee's (Claire Trevor) rich sister.

title: The Set-Up
description: An aging boxer (Robert Ryan) leaves his crying wife (Audrey Totter), then crosses the street for a fixed fight.

title: This Could Be the Night
description: A prim teacher (Jean Simmons) works in a New York nightclub run by a gruff ex-bootlegger (Paul Douglas) and his suave partner (Anthony Franciosa).

title: Odds Against Tomorrow
description: Racial tension flares up among an ex-cop, a bigot and a black entertainer who band together to rob a bank.

title: The Haunting
description: An anthropologist (Richard Johnson), an heir and two ESP-prone women (Julie Harris, Claire Bloom) explore a New England mansion.

title: Spartacus
description: A gladiator slave (Kirk Douglas) leads a revolt in decadent Rome and attempts to lead his followers to freedom.

title: Lolita
description: Professor Humbert Humbert (James Mason) marries a widow (Shelley Winters) to be near her nymphet daughter (Sue Lyon).

title: Dr. Strangelove Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
description: President Muffley and his advisers man the Pentagon war room, as planes with bombs head toward Moscow.

title: Metropolis
description: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the working class and the city planners, the son of the city's mastermind falls in love with a working-class prophet who predicts the coming of a savior to mediate their differences.

title: 42nd Street
description: A Broadway producer (Warner Baxter) sends in the understudy (Ruby Keeler) when his show's star (Bebe Daniels) twists her ankle.

title: Gold Diggers of 1933
description: A songwriter's (Dick Powell) big check puts chorus girls (Joan Blondell, Ruby Keeler) to work but incurs his brother's wrath.

title: On the Town
description: Sailors Gabey (Gene Kelly), Chip (Frank Sinatra) and Ozzie have 24 hours to meet pretty women and see the sights of New York.

title: Lullaby of Broadway
description: A London stage star (Doris Day) returns to New York and finds her mother (Gladys George), once on Broadway, has taken to drink.

title: I Love Melvin
description: A magazine photographer's helper (Donald O'Connor) rashly promises to put a chorus girl (Debbie Reynolds) on the cover.

title: My Sister Eileen
description: Two Ohio sisters (Janet Leigh, Betty Garrett) move to Greenwich Village, where one finds a publisher (Jack Lemmon) and the other one finds men.

title: Bells Are Ringing
description: A busybody telephone operator (Judy Holliday) falls for a writer (Dean Martin) experiencing a creative slump.

title: Ennio
description: Giuseppe Tornatore pays tribute to Ennio Morricone in a documentary portrait of the prolific composer, exploring the breadth of the maestro's career across the hundreds of film scores he wrote.

title: A Fistful of Dollars
description: Wandering gunfighter Joe arrives in the Mexican village of San Miguel in the midst of a power struggle among sheriff John Baxter and the three Rojo brothers. He is hired by Esteban Rojo to join their gang, but he plays one side against the other.

title: The Great Silence
description: The mountains in winter provide the backdrop for this tale of a mute gunslinger who battles a band of bounty hunters.

title: The Mission
description: A Spanish slave trader (Robert De Niro) joins a Jesuit (Jeremy Irons) at a jungle mission in politically torn 1750 South America.

title: The Battle of Algiers
description: Between 1954 and '62, Algeria fights for independence from the French.

title: The Time Machine
description: H.G. Wells' time traveler journeys through time, experiencing several civilizations. Oscar-winning special effects.

title: Batman and Robin
description:
S01 E11 — Robin's Ruse
The duo plan to lure the Wizard from his secret lair.

title: Dr. Kildare's Crisis
description: Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) corrects Kildare's (Lew Ayres) diagnosis of nurse Lamont's brother's (Robert Young) head problem.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Odor of the Day
A dog finds shelter with a skunk during a snow storm.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Touche and Go
Pepé le Pew pursues a cat by the seaside, under the sea and on a desert island.

title: The Strip
description: A jazz drummer (Mickey Rooney) back from Korea meets a cigarette girl (Sally Forrest) and mobsters on Hollywood's Sunset Strip.

title: The Big Sleep
description: Raymond Chandler's private eye Philip Marlowe (Humphrey Bogart) follows two wealthy sisters (Lauren Bacall, Martha Vickers) through a maze of murders.

title: Action in the North Atlantic
description: The captain (Raymond Massey), mates (Humphrey Bogart, Alan Hale) and crew of a Liberty Ship dodge U-boats, dive bombers and foul weather to reach port.

title: The Americanization of Emily
description: A Navy officer (James Garner), ordered to document the first D-Day fatality, wines and dines a London widow (Julie Andrews).

title: Kanał
description: Polish partisans (Teresa Izewska, Tadeusz Janczar, Wisczyslaw Glinski) hide from the Nazis in the sewers of Warsaw.

title: Salvatore Giuliano
description: An outlaw goes to work for separatist politicians during the 1940s.

title: Jeopardy
description: A woman (Barbara Stanwyck) lures a fugitive (Ralph Meeker) to help her husband (Barry Sullivan), trapped under a piling at low tide.

title: Executive Action
description: Three powerful conspirators (Burt Lancaster, Robert Ryan, Will Geer) plot the assassination of President John F. Kennedy.

title: St. Ives
description: A dabbler-in-crime (John Houseman) and his assistant (Jacqueline Bisset) hire an ex-police reporter (Charles Bronson) to recover some stolen papers.

title: The Fastest Guitar Alive
description: A Rebel spy (Roy Orbison) with a shotgun guitar robs a mint with his partner (Sammy Jackson), then learns Lee has surrendered.

title: Spade Cooley: King of Western Swing
description: The rise in popularity of Cooley's blend of country and swing music.

title: Bob Wills and His Texas Playboys
description: A bridge between four classics of Bob Wills.

title: A Time to Sing
description: A Southerner (Hank Williams Jr.) turns country singer despite his guardian (Ed Begley) and falls for a tobacco farmer's daughter (Shelley Fabares).

title: Jeopardy
description: A woman (Barbara Stanwyck) lures a fugitive (Ralph Meeker) to help her husband (Barry Sullivan), trapped under a piling at low tide.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Canary Row
Sylvester spots Tweety inside the Broken Arms Hotel, but no cats are allowed in the lobby, so Sylvester has to think up other means of getting in.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Hare Trimmed
Granny gets into a love triangle, with Sam and Bugs both fighting for her hand in marriage; Sam wants Granny's money, and Bugs want to help Granny.

title: Father's Little Dividend
description: Father (Spencer Tracy) hears Daughter (Elizabeth Taylor) is pregnant in this sequel to Father of the Bride.
